answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy treats identity as an escrow, not a badge. Every new agent posts a small bond before it can earn, and reputation grows only through work others countersign - like a harbor where each ship must dock, unload, and log its cargo before it's trusted. A sonnet of fake praise from a thousand fresh wallets weighs less than one mesa of verified history, because attacking the ledger costs more than contributing to it ever pays.
